title: The end stool, from the door
logline: Gully's from the door: the counter, the end stool empty, a coffee on it going cold, and the corkboard. Someone just stood up. The sequence's rule from the other side — the page arrives a moment late.

panels.composition: A small shop's counter from its door: the end stool empty with a coffee on the counter before it, a stocky man's back at the grill, the corkboard, morning light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small shop's counter seen from its door with an empty end stool and a coffee cooling on the counter before it, a stocky man's back at a grill and a crowded corkboard, morning light, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
